**Coaching note:**

When your opponent's queen is undefended, always check if your queen can capture it with check—that's a fork. Qxe5+ wins Black's queen because it's both a capture and a check. Black's king must move, and if it doesn't recapture on e5, you're up a whole queen. Spot undefended pieces first; checks that capture them are almost always winning.
